source.title: Profitability of simple technical trading rules of Chinese stock exchange indexes

claims.statement: TRB buy and short signals cross the 50-day historical maximum or minimum with band 0.01.
claims.implementation: ChannelBreakout.decide: ceiling, floor, previous and price

claims.statement: Ignore new signals during the fixed C=10-day holding period.

adaptations: The trading index is replaced with pinned public AAPL OHLCV as an execution proxy; original SHCI/SZCI results are not reproduced.
The ten holding sessions are counted after the signal close; entry fills at the next opening and exit at the opening following the tenth held session.
Short target positions express the paper's short signal even though its Chinese-market investment discussion separately considers no-short-sale results.
